scope: LOCAL_ANVIL_ONLY: signed SIWE -> Web BFF -> Core -> dedicated PostgreSQL fixture table. No wallet transaction, cloud data modification, model call or UX/tab changes.
checks: Anonymous request cannot access the fixture account data
Regular signed user cannot select synthetic operator/personas
Operator reads the seeded PostgreSQL snapshot with eight stores and 48 monthly sales records
All seven selectable personas receive scoped portfolio, claims and store-management data
New investor/customer empty states and existing multi-store portfolio are distinct
Single-store and multi-store merchants retain separate ownership scopes
Correction overpayment and partially unpaid/matured claims remain visible
Reviewer and operator example sections have different datasets
Background participant and unknown IDs cannot be selected as login personas
Preview reads do not change active offering, real ledger, jobs or actual account role
Synthetic holdings do not claim real GIWA balances or transactions
